name: agent-context
description: Project memory as seven plain markdown files: task handoff, project map, commands, and lessons. No index, no database, no MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Project memory in plain markdown. No index, no daemon, no MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent forgets everything between sessions. This fixes that with seven markdown files in .agent-context/ — current task handoff, progress ledger, project map, commands, config locations, conventions, and lessons learned — that the agent writes and reads on its own. Ships bootstrap-context, handoff, sync-context, and update-progress skills plus SessionStart and Stop hooks. Unlike graph- or vector-based memory tools, there is nothing to index and no service to run: the hooks are Python standard library only, and the same source installs into both Cursor and Codex.
